## Business Scope
Alpha Energie GmbH is a leading provider of sustainable energy solutions in the B2B sector. Services include energy consulting (Energieberatung), photovoltaic (solar) installations, green energy contracts (Ökostrom/Ökogas), energy audits, and a dedicated portal for sales partners (Vertriebspartner).

## Pages & Structure
- `/ueber-uns.html`: About the company and team
- `/gewerbekunden.html`: Services for business clients (B2B)
- `/vertriebspartner.html`: Information for sales partners
- `/photovoltaik.html`: Solar and PV solutions
- `/energie-audits.html`: Energy audits and consulting
- `/kontakt.html`: Contact information
